structural-causal.name: bottleneckControl
structural-causal.basis: Large operating liquefaction infrastructure and completed Stage 3 capacity create hard-to-replicate physical conversion capacity.

structural-causal.name: scenarioRobustness
structural-causal.basis: Contracted LNG infrastructure can remain useful across gas-price scenarios, while utilization and expansion returns remain exposed to spreads, feedgas and regulation.

structural-causal.name: substitutionResilience
structural-causal.basis: LNG serves dispatchable energy and industrial demand but competes over time with domestic gas use, renewables-plus-storage, nuclear and other supply routes.

discovery-weak-signals.name: raised 2026 guidance
discovery-weak-signals.basis: Management raised current-year adjusted EBITDA and distributable cash flow expectations.

discovery-weak-signals.name: CCL Stage 3 completion
discovery-weak-signals.basis: Project completion converts construction risk into operating capacity.

adversarial-red-team.name: financingResilience
adversarial-red-team.basis: Large fixed infrastructure supports cash generation but substantial debt and future expansion capex reduce error tolerance.

adversarial-red-team.name: confidenceInflation
adversarial-red-team.basis: Raised guidance and completed trains should not be extrapolated into guaranteed future expansion returns.

expectations-execution.name: execution conversion
expectations-execution.basis: Completed Stage 3 capacity and raised guidance are realized milestones.
